description: Joosep Niinemägi deposited three Simulink models as supplementary material for a master's thesis on partial-power converters for powering the Future Circular Collider. The thesis was conducted in collaboration between CERN and TalTech. The repository lists three SLX files named Half_Bridge_Upload, DAB_Upload and PPC_Upload. They provide existing electrical-converter simulation models for examining the proposed facility's power-supply arrangements. The models have no stated geographic calibration area or calendar simulation period. TalTech offers public file access under CC BY 4.0 at no stated charge; running the models requires the relevant MATLAB/Simulink environment, whose costs are separate. The public metadata do not state solver settings, required software version, parameter definitions, time resolution or validation results. The files were not downloaded or executed, so reproducibility has not been tested. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
